=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-540]] is assessed at 84% (probable). William Melanchthon Glasgow’s family history lists Mary among Hugh and Sally Blair’s seven children after their 1777 marriage. Hugh’s 1827 will omits Mary, which does not contradict the earlier list but leaves her individual adult identity poorly documented.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Read the complete Mary passage and supporting family papers.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf William Melanchthon Glasgow, History of the Glasgow Family (https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
